coverageNotes: Gap list X03: 20 names checked, 15 recorded, 5 left out. NONE OF THE 20 WAS ALREADY IN THE DATASET: all raw files were searched by name and alias, and the only hits were notes in E01 (Coinbase), E04 (Sun Life), E12 (Bayer), G05 (CME Group and Dover as unverified Bagmane tenants) and G17 (Avery Dennison as an unverified Peenya name). METHOD: the shared web-search budget was used up before this run started, so no search-engine queries were made. Every finding comes from direct fetches of company pages (MODEC, Guidewire, Celonis, Dolby, Samsara, Anthropic, JLL, Acuity, Avery Dennison, Rockstar/Wikipedia), the GLEIF legal-entity registry API (registered addresses, creation dates, parent links) and the OSM extracts. A GLEIF registered address alone is graded medium, because a registered office need not be the working office; Samsara shows the gap, with a registered office at Brigade IRV and a careers-page office at Gopalan Fortune City. LEFT OUT, NOT PLACEABLE IN BENGALURU: (1) Coinbase: both Indian entities (Coinbase India, Coinbase India Services) are registered in Malviya Nagar, New Delhi, and no Bengaluru office was found. This agrees with E01. (2) Bayer: all eight Indian Bayer entities in GLEIF are registered at Bayer House, Thane. bayer.com/en/in returned 403, and E12 had already documented the Bengaluru captive (~1,100 staff) without an address. (3) Ferguson: Ferguson Global India is registered at WeWork Berger Delhi One, Noida. Ferguson's sites sit behind a Cloudflare challenge and ANSR's sitemap has no news pages, so no Bengaluru building was found for the ANSR-built GCC. (4) Alvarez & Marsal: A&M Global Capability Center Pvt Ltd is registered at DLF Cyber City, Gurugram, and A&M India in Lower Parel, Mumbai. alvarezandmarsal.com refused every fetch with 403, so the Bengaluru digital/AI centre could not be placed. (5) Sun Life: Sun Life Global Solutions is registered at Pioneer Square, Sector 62, Gurugram, and no Bengaluru site could be substantiated. PARTIAL: JLL: the critic's 'Level 3, Concorde, UB City' could not be verified, because jll.com/en-in/locations/bangalore fills its address in by script and the address is not in the HTML. Only JLL's own 2018 and 2019 releases on the TDIM centre of excellence at Prestige Trade Tower are recorded, at medium confidence because occupancy after 2019 is not confirmed. Avery Dennison: no Bengaluru 'capability centre' was found; the Peenya RBIS site is recorded instead. Dover: the PSG and Markem-Imaje labs were not placed, and Markem-Imaje India is registered in New Delhi. Rockstar India: the studio pin uses the LLP's registered office (Prestige Shantiniketan Tower C; parent Take-Two; created 2016, the year the studio was set up). The Jayanagar address of the 1998 company acquired with Dhruva is recorded at low confidence as a likely registered office only. Acuity Knowledge Partners now trades as Acuity Analytics (acuitykp.com redirects to acuityanalytics.com), so it is filed under the new name with the old one as an alias. GODREJ CENTRE RESOLVED: TOYO MODEC's 'Godrej Centre Indiranagar' is the Old Madras Road building at B.M. Kaval, 560038 (OSM way/998192575, about 12.988, 77.647). It is not the Hebbal Godrej Centre / Godrej Downtown that the dataset uses for Accenture (OSM way/1040899007). G08's mention of a 'Godrej Centre in Hebbal' for Hitachi Energy should be checked against this. AREA-LEVEL PINS, deliberately graded medium: Celonis (the Table Space Towers building would not geocode, so the pin is the Devasandra Industrial Estate centroid, about 0.5-1 km uncertainty), Avery Dennison (Peenya Industrial Area centroid), Dolby (Embassy TechVillage centroid), Abercrombie & Fitch (Manyata centroid) and Samsara Gopalan (park centroid). BY-CATCH for whoever handles the Zynga gap: GLEIF registers ZYNGA GAME NETWORK INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED at Prestige Falcon Tower, 4th & 5th Floor, 19 Brunton Road, Richmond Town, Bengaluru 560025 (LEI 335800HBAT9DKGT1JK25). It was not added here because Zynga is not on this list.
